programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 4
programme.desc: The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 5
programme.desc: Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 6
programme.desc: Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Lake Otamangakau
programme.desc: Andrew Harding and Matt Hince team up to visit a huge man-made lake - one of New Zealand's most famous trophy trout waters - in the country's North Island: Lake Otamangakau.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Southland Smelters
programme.desc: New Zealand's Southland's four major rivers are famous as brown trout fisheries, especially in the upper and middle sections, but in this episode Anto Hall and Mike Wilkinson are heading to the estuaries, to fish the annual smelt run.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Golden Bay Kingfish
programme.desc: Discovering new waters to fish is among the pinnacles of the fly fishing experience, and this saltwater flats fishery, Golden Bay, is just such a gem. Kingfish have a unique relationship with short-tailed stingrays, which they use as mobile cover.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Backcountry Kaimanawas
programme.desc: This episode of Pure Fly NZ sees a helicopter ride take anglers Cory Scott and Chris Charland deep into the the mountains to target New Zealand's famous trophy trout, but will an approaching weather-bomb cause them a headache.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Tauranga Taupo
programme.desc: Lake Taupo was formed in the caldera caused by an enormous volcanic explosion. The Tauranga is one of the few tributaries that the lake's legendary rainbow trout use to spawn.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Autumn Chromers
programme.desc: The South Island's Otago Lakes District is the location for remarkable autumn trout fishing brought about by the fish leaving the lakes and heading upstream to spawn.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: Da Lisa vågner op på hospitalet, kan hun ikke huske noget: Hun kan ikke huske, hvem hun er, at hendes mand ønsker at lade sig skilles. Da hendes mand tager hende med hjem, må Lisa lære alting forfra. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne mistænker, at hendes bror Alans død ikke var et uheld, og beslutter sig for at undersøge sagen. Hun begynder at arbejde for den magtfulde familie, der muligvis har haft en finger med i spillet. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En forældreløs piges (Mel Harris) søgen efter sin fortid begynder med et barndomsfoto af hende selv ved siden af en sjælden spilledåse og fører hende til en forførende skattejæger. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: Liz, en smuk barnepige, giver nyt liv til Richard Keaton, en enkemand og videnskabsmand, og hans begavede, men fremmedgjorte søn Andy. Liz' liv er i fare, da hun kommer for tæt på sandheden. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Awakening
programme.desc: Da en dusørjæger, der er på sporet af en af hendes lejere, overbeviser Sara McAllister om at slå sig sammen med ham, begynder de et eventyr i den farlige verden af international spionage og kærlighed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage

programme.title: Double Jeopardy (1955)
programme.desc: En ejendomsmægler bliver tiltalt for et mord, han ikke har begået, og han beslutter sig for at bevise, at han er uskyldig.

programme.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
programme.sub-title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
programme.desc: En udlejer har mistanke om, at hendes nye logerende er galningen, der dræber kvinder i London.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banana Joe er ellers sådan en fredelig fyr, men nu har han ikke noget andet valg end, på ægte 'Bud Spencer' manér, at smide mafiaen ud af landsbyen Amanlido, så der igen kan blive fredeligt at bo der!

programme.title: The Country Girl
programme.desc: Grace Kelly received an Oscar for her portrayal of the wife, and Bing Crosby played an alcoholic, has-been actor. When he is given an opportunity to star in a new musical show, his wife attempts to help him make a comeback.

programme.title: Tyve & røvere
programme.desc: 280 Punds øretæver bliver sluppet løs på Miamis intetanende mafia! "Tyve & røvere" foregår i Miami og handler om den hårdtprøvede betjent Parker (Bud Spencer), der bliver sendt ud for at fange den lille og uinteressante tyveknægt Roma (Tomas Milian).

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: Mens Jack Deebs sad i fængsel, fandt han en måde at slippe derfra ved at skabe Cool World, en tegneserie med en smuk kvinde ved navn Holli Would. Kødet viser sig dog at være svagere end blæk, da Holli tager menneskeform i Las Vegas.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: Gi' den hele armen
programme.desc: Trinity brødrene, som vi har vredet os af grin over som western helte, skal her opleves som luftens cowboys. Luften over Sydamerika er blevet temmelig usikker. De to helte skal sørge for at få gamle højt forsikrede flyvemaskiner til at styrte ned.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell

programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.sub-title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während die Kandidaten unter den wachsamen Augen von General Fero dem ultimativen Sieg entgegenstolpern. Hoffentlich können sie sich lang genug am Fliegenpilz festklammern, um zur Burg von Takeshi zu gelangen.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia: 506
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während die neuen Kandidaten einen wunden Po in 'Strandgammler' bekommen und sich einen Weg über das 'harte Pflaster' bahnen, bis sie die Burg von Takeshi einnehmen können.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Einhundert Kandidaten versuchen, dem Wasser (und den Dämonen) der Bienenwabe zu entkommen und riesige Kugeln im Bowlingspiel zu bezwingen. Sie wollen die Bürg stürmen und gewinnen. Wird es ihnen gelingen? Roman Kemp moderiert.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während sich einhundert mutige Kandidaten ihren Weg zur Burg von Takeshi erkämpfen. Es gibt Wasser, Matsch und fliegende Pilze. Nur die Starken schaffen es bis zur Burg.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während sich neue Kandidaten ihren Weg zur Burg von Takeshi erkämpfen. Doch wird es ihnen gelingen, trotz Rutschwand, Strandgammler und Fliegenpilz den Sieg für sich zu beanspruchen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während 100 Kandidaten Herausforderungen wie die lustige Rutschwand bezwingen, um die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen. Haben sie das Zeug, die Wachen zu besiegen und den Sieg für sich zu beanspruchen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Eine brandneue Staffel von 'Takeshi’s Castle' mit 100 mutigen Kandidaten. Euch erwarten Spaß, Stürze und natürlich Niederlagen! Roman Kemp überwacht den Wahnsinn, darunter auch den Takeshi-Klassiker 'Bienenwabe'.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Einhundert mutige neue Kandidaten bezwingen neue Takeshi-Aufgaben wie den 'Drahtseilakt' und 'Jetzt siehst du mich' auf ihrer Mission, als Sieger die Burg zu stürmen. Wird es ihnen gelingen? Moderiert von Roman Kemp.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: 100 Kandidaten riskieren alles, um die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen. Werden sie die Rutschwand bezwingen und das richtige Loch in der Fallgrube auswählen? Roman Kemp moderiert den Wahnsinn.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Werden die Kandidaten dieser Woche die Hängebrücke bezwingen? Gelingt es ihnen, die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen? Findet es gemeinsam mit Moderator Roman Kemp heraus.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während 100 neue Kandidaten in Spielen wie 'Bienenwabe' und 'Der große Jäger' auf die Probe gestellt werden. Wird es ihnen gelingen, die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Takeshi’s Castle geht in eine neue Runde, und Moderator Roman Kemp versucht, ein wenig Ordnung in die verrückteste aller Spielshows zu bringen. Lacher und Niederlagen säumen den Weg entlang der verschiedenen Spiele.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert das brandneue 'Takeshi’s Castle'. Erkämpfen sich die Kandidaten ihren Weg ins Finale, oder macht ihnen der 'Drahtseilakt' oder die 'Fallgrube' einen Strich durch die Rechnung?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: In der brandneuen Version von 'Takeshi’s Castle' bezwingen die Kandidaten die lustige Rutschwand und die bekannte Bienenwabe. Wer wird diese Woche gewinnen? Findet es gemeinsam mit Moderator Roman Kemp heraus.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Willkommen zurück zum lustigen 'Takeshi’s Castle'! Erlebt gemeinsam mit Roman Kemp eine Menge Spaß. Einhundert Kandidaten kämpfen um das Finale, aber machen ihnen die Rutschwand oder die Bienenwabe einen Strich durch die Rechnung?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Staffelfinale der urkomischen Serie 'Takeshis’s Castle'! Erlebt den Wahnsinn gemeinsam mit Roman Kemp. Die Kandidaten müssen den Fliegenpilz und eine rutschige Wand bezwingen, bevor sie zur Burg gelangen.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
